title: Good bed
text: Good bed. I purchased this bed for my son for his room because he turned 15 and he's now a man so.... Anyway, the bed came while at work and he managed to drag it into the house with the help of UPS. He then decides he can assemble the bed alone so this bed was badly assembled by my 15 year old son in a few  hours. I came home to a fully assembled (and standing) bed that for the past two months have held him in the air quite well. Now there a couple pieces that are backwards and would need to be turned around but the bed and desk are standing and it doesn't rock ( a miracle really). I say this to say, the bed assembly is not rocket science. Do it with help of course but it's a good price for the kind of bed it is. Good luck to all...
